data.long_meaning: Bhavitha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhava’ which means existence or experience. This name symbolizes the divine feminine and the power of creation. The name Bhavitha carries the meaning “Existence, Experience” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhavitha usually hope their child will grow to embody existence, experience and live with faith, good character and purpose.
